sloka: न हि रामो महातेजाः शक्यो जेतुं सुरासुरैः ।राक्षसैर्वापि चान्यैर्वा स्वर्गः पापजनैरिव ।। ५.२७.२१।।।।
transliteration: na hi rāmo mahātejāḥ śakyo jetuṁ surāsuraiḥ ।rākṣasairvāpi cānyairvā svargaḥ pāpajanairiva ।। 5.27.21।।।।

translations.english: "Just as a sinner cannot attain heaven Rama cannot be won by gods or demons, even rakshasas and others.
